invented.quote: The supply boat won't come again until spring.
invented.why: The brief only states that the game is about seeing a lighthouse keeper's family through a winter, without mentioning a supply boat.

invented.quote: That's more than two games per person, because people who played it asked to play again.
invented.why: The brief gives the number of playtest sessions and players, which doesn't even prove an average of more than two games per person since a game holds up to 4 players, and it gives no reason why people played multiple times.

invented.quote: when people play it, they come back.
invented.why: The brief does not state that playtesters returned on their own initiative or asked to play again.

invented.quote: The rest covers platform and payment fees and leaves room for surprises.
invented.why: The brief does not state how the remaining money between the $28,000 goal and the printing and shipping costs will be allocated.

invented.quote: This campaign doesn't pay my salary, because I already have one. Every dollar goes to the game.
invented.why: The brief mentions the creator works full time as a land surveyor, but does not state whether they are taking any pay from the campaign funds.

invented.quote: And I'll post an update every month, from the day the campaign closes until the game is at your door. If anything slips, you'll hear it from me first.
invented.why: The brief makes no mention of an update schedule or a communication plan after the campaign closes.

invented.quote: If we don't, there's no print run, and this winter stays on my kitchen table.
invented.why: The brief does not say what the creator will do if the crowdfunding goal is not met, nor does it mention a kitchen table.
